title: Checklist Completion Rate Trend
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cleaning:checklist items_completed=* items_total=*
| eval completion_pct=round(100*items_completed/nullif(items_total,0),1)
| timechart span=1w avg(completion_pct) as avg_completion by checklist_name
| fillnull value=0
description: Trends weekly average completion percentage for each household cleaning checklist.
value: Completion drift shows when routines collapse after travel or busy seasons and need a reset.
implementation: Log `items_completed` and `items_total` per checklist run and chart weekly averages.
visualization: Multi-series line chart of completion percent by checklist.
grandmaExplanation: It counts whether you are finishing your cleaning checklists or letting items slide.
